about.title: San Clemente Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: San Clemente's roadways, including the I-5 corridor and busy stretches of Avenida Pico and El Camino Real, see hundreds of injury collisions each year, and occasionally a crash proves fatal. When that happens, the grief is immediate, but so are practical burdens: funeral arrangements, lost income the family depended on, and unanswered questions about what happened. California law gives certain surviving family members, starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, the right to pursue a wrongful death claim against the party responsible. This is a separate civil matter from any police investigation or criminal charges. LawProactive doesn't practice law ourselves; we're a free service that connects Orange County families with an independent personal injury attorney who handles wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery. If your family is grieving a preventable loss, reaching out costs nothing and puts you under no obligation.

Loss of companionship, guidance, and care
Loss of the deceased's expected future earnings
Medical costs incurred before death, where applicable

whyChoose.title: What Families in San Clemente Should Understand

items.title: Only Certain Family Members Qualify
items.desc: California limits who may file, generally starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, then extending to other dependents or heirs if none exist. An attorney can help determine where your family stands.

items.title: The Clock Starts Running Quickly
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, though claims against a government entity carry a much shorter deadline. Waiting can quietly close off options your family didn't know it had.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Bills
items.desc: California law allows families to seek compensation not just for funeral costs and lost financial support, but for the loss of love, companionship, and guidance the person provided. An attorney can help you understand what applies to your situation.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action, even if the driver also faces criminal charges. The civil case focuses on compensating the family, and it moves on its own timeline regardless of how any criminal matter is resolved.

items.question: Does San Clemente's traffic pattern matter to our case?
items.answer: Public crash records show San Clemente sees higher collision volumes on Saturday afternoons and along corridors like I-5, Avenida Pico, and El Camino Real. That context can help an attorney understand the circumstances, but every case turns on its own facts and evidence.

items.question: What if we're not sure whether we qualify to file?
items.answer: California law prioritizes spouses, domestic partners, and children, then other dependents if none exist, so eligibility isn't always obvious. An independent attorney can review your family's situation and explain where you stand at no cost to you.
